choices.name: Store pledges
choices.description: Extend Common stewardship through reciprocal reserve obligations. Every hearth gains 2 food before local penalties.

choices.name: Harvest councils
choices.description: Local stewards coordinate planting and shared repairs. Every hearth gains 2 food and 1 industry.

choices.name: Open ledgers
choices.description: Extend the Charter compact with records that can travel between markets. Every hearth gains 2 coin and 1 knowledge.

choices.name: Itinerant courts
choices.description: Travelling witnesses settle obligations across the realm. Every hearth gains 2 coin and 1 industry.

choices.name: Watched ranks
choices.description: Carry Shield cohesion into an established system of mutual watches. Every fighting formation gains 1 armor and 4 battle morale.

choices.name: Standing reserve
choices.description: Keep trained replacements and reserve equipment ready for the line. Every fighting formation gains 1 armor and 1 attack; this does not heal existing losses.

choices.name: Dispatch cells
choices.description: Extend March columns with compact groups trained to pass orders. Every fighting formation gains 2 initiative.

choices.name: Disciplined momentum
choices.description: A moving column keeps enough order to strike together. Every fighting formation gains 2 attack and 4 battle morale.

events.message: First Ember expanded its civic boundary to hex 13972 after accumulating 40 border progress. No workers or improvements were assigned.
North Ledger was founded. The hearth caravan has settled.
North Ledger queued Cinder workshop for 12 coin.
North Ledger queued Root cellar for 8 coin.
Contained ember projection was researched for 36 knowledge. A personally qualified caster is still required.
Edrin Coalstead 2 was appointed Waykeeper for 40 coin.

technologyChoices.name: Cinder masonry
technologyChoices.description: Reusable kiln forms strengthen hearthland workshops. Every settlement gains 2 industry before devastation, occupation and blockade penalties.

technologyChoices.name: Civic accounts
technologyChoices.description: Public ledgers reconnect the bargains once carried by the Witness Roads. Every settlement gains 1 coin and 1 knowledge before penalties; enables the Hearth Exchange.

technologyChoices.name: Coastal navigation
technologyChoices.description: Soundings and shore charts reconnect coastal hearthlands. Enables Charter harbors, transports and Coastwatch galleys; vessels can travel coastal shallows. This practical knowledge does not confer magical aptitude.

technologyChoices.name: Ocean navigation
technologyChoices.description: Deep-water charts and long-voyage rigging open the ocean. Ocean-capable transports and Deepwake warships may cross deep water; coastal galleys remain restricted to shallows.

technologyChoices.name: Seasonal stewardship
technologyChoices.description: Record planting and water-sharing obligations. Unlocks Spring gardens on fresh-water land; opens the waterworks, forestry and surveyed-estates branches. Knowledge alone does not build or work a tile.

technologyChoices.name: Sluice waterworks
technologyChoices.description: Controlled sluices support worked wetland Polders. They can feed crowded settlements, but old growth and Ashfall glass make intensive planting less productive. Physical terrain and natural features remain intact.

technologyChoices.name: Surveyed estates
technologyChoices.description: Witnessed boundary surveys add one civic progress per active settlement turn toward automatic border expansion. Claims still require connected, charted land within the settlement’s reach; siege and occupation halt expansion.

technologyChoices.name: Charter forestry
technologyChoices.description: Bind cutting rights to the preservation of living records. Unlocks Grove archives on old-growth woodland: knowledge and modest industry instead of the woodlot’s stronger extraction.

technologyChoices.name: Counterweighted cranes
technologyChoices.description: Reusable lifting frames unlock Oreworks on mineral seams. Worked Oreworks favor industry at the cost of food and coin; wet ground complicates extraction.

technologyChoices.name: Deep soundings
technologyChoices.description: Observations from the shore compare returning ships’ ocean records. Unlocks Tide observatories on coastal shallows; knowledge replaces the food-focused role of a fishery. Does not extend worker reach into deep ocean.

institutionChoices.name: Charter compact
institutionChoices.description: Recognize shared market charters. Every settlement gains 2 coin before penalties; enables the Hearth Exchange. Permanently excludes Common stewardship.
institutionChoices.blocker: An institution has already been adopted; this choice is permanent.

institutionChoices.name: Common stewardship
institutionChoices.description: Communal stores take priority over merchant privileges. Every settlement gains 3 food before penalties; enables the Hearth Exchange. Permanently excludes Charter compact.
institutionChoices.blocker: An institution has already been adopted; this choice is permanent.

doctrineChoices.name: Shield cohesion
doctrineChoices.description: Train formations to cover one another. Armies gain 2 armor in battle. Permanently excludes March columns.

doctrineChoices.name: March columns
doctrineChoices.description: Organize disciplined marching relays. Armies regain 1 additional strategic movement each turn. Permanently excludes Shield cohesion.

project.name: Hearth Exchange
project.description: Host a great exchange supported by three settlements with Charter markets and Witness archives. Sustain its full active period; blockades and conquest can interrupt the endeavor. Funding and duration depend on campaign pace.
blockers: Maintain 3 unoccupied settlements, each with a Charter market and Witness archive.
Requires 18000 coin upfront; cancellation gives no refund.
